remarks: A RARE OPPORTUNITY FOR FIVE-STAR RESORT LUXURY LIVING WITH ACCESS TO THE WALDORF ASTORIA MONARCH BEACH RESORT. Located within the exclusive, gated community of The Grand Monarch in Dana Point, this exceptional residence offers an elevated coastal lifestyle with access to Waldorf Astoria resort amenities, including pools and a fitness center. Built in 2021, this four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home sits on a desirable corner lot with ocean views. Thoughtfully designed for sophisticated living and effortless entertaining, the residence blends elegant interiors, refined upgrades, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.
